sentences.show: A bomb went off by accident, and 2,000 years of emperors came to an end.
The uprising began on this day in 1911, in Wuchang, China.
Revolutionaries were secretly building bombs to overthrow the Qing dynasty.
On 9 October, one of them exploded by mistake.
The police came looking. Their names were exposed.
Facing arrest, the soldiers in the plot struck first.
By morning, the governor had fled, and Wuchang was theirs.
The revolution's leader, Sun Yat-sen, was in America, raising money.
He couldn't decode the telegram. He read about the uprising in a newspaper.
Within weeks, province after province broke away.
On New Year's Day, Sun became the first president of the Republic of China.
Weeks later, the last emperor gave up the throne. He was six years old.
Also on this day: Neptune's largest moon was discovered, and Emmeline Pankhurst founded the suffragettes' union.
